Apply a host class to give the placeholder approximately the same size as the content it represents.

## Usage

```ts
import { skeleton, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/skeleton';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/skeleton`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-skeleton"></a>

### `shadcn.Skeleton`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Skeleton`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `null \| string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |

No slots.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
